module: Flowgraph node "Get Drag Racer Spawn Point" (category repeat_instant). Gives the spawn position and rotation of a driver's lane (vehId), generally used once during preparation. Outputs: spawnPos (vec3), spawnRot (quat), lane, available (false if the driver, the lane or the spawn waypoint cannot be found).

work.desc: Reads dragData.strip.lanes[lane].waypoints.spawn.transform and writes the used pins.
